svg.title: Runtime Architecture (Torok)
svg.desc: Six layers: the host application (human, agent and workflow, tool functions, resident configuration), Torok's typed surfaces (HTTP adapter, Go API, tool package, resident service), the Program and Runtime contract, the execution engine with shared limits, leases, intent commits and run states, the model, spend, storage and tool adapters, and the external systems they reach. A strip shows the resident service's inbox, admission, episodes, receipts and archive.
svg.metadata: Generic component icons derived from Tabler Icons 3.45.0, MIT License. Product marks copyright their projects.
svg.text: One engine runs the tool loop, checks typed answers and commits progress; work resumes after human input or a process restart.
one Go module · runs inside the host process · Go 1.27

g.aria-label: Agent · Workflow. immutable config. model · tools · checks. Flow in a Go function
Tool Functions. typed in and out. ordinary Go functions. tool.Func · ReadOnly
Resident Config. one identity. state dir · budget. observers · schedules
HTTP Adapter. runs · input · SSE. service routes · auth. torokhttp
Typed Go API. Run · RunAs[T] · Flow. Session · Runtime. torok
Tool Package. frozen typed catalog. ReadOnly · approval. tool
Resident Service. inbox · schedules. memory · observers. service
Model Adapter. Responses · Chat. one inference per call. model
Spend Ledger. reserves before HTTP. allowance · grace · ceiling. model.Spend
Storage. memory or SQLite · WAL. atomic state + events. store/sqlite
MCP Client. stdio · frozen catalog. owns its child process. tool/mcp
Web Retrieval. bounded HTTPS · PDF text. exact public hosts. tool/web
Process Tool. bounded time · output. owned process group. tool/command
Model Endpoint. explicit endpoint. HTTPS · streamed text
State Directory. private SQLite files. app owns retention
MCP Servers. e.g. Canary. JSON-RPC 2.0 · stdio
Public Sources. allow-listed hosts. text · PDF
Local Processes. explicit executable. not an OS sandbox

svg.text: one Serve owner per state directory · idle waiting costs no inference
proof/Acceptance.lean models the acceptance boundary in Lean 4 and CI checks it · Go 1.27 · three direct dependencies: modernc sqlite, jsonschema, a PDF reader
